Community. Values. Long-lasting relationships.

Meet Gabriel.

Sierra Verde Landscaping is a family-owned business serving San Diego residential and commercial properties since 2021. Gabriel started the company on the belief that good landscaping is about showing up — consistently, on time, with care — for the same clients year after year.

That's how every account is run today: the same crew sees your property every visit, learns what works for your specific yard, and takes ownership of the long-term result.

Recent work

A few yards we're proud of.

See All Projects

La Jolla

Drought-Tolerant Front Yard

Replaced 1,400 sq ft of thirsty turf with a layered drought-tolerant palette and converted four irrigation zones to drip. Water bill dropped ~60% in the first month.

North Park

Backyard Lawn Restoration

Brought a patchy, compacted backyard lawn back to a usable family space — aeration, overseed with shade-tolerant Tall Fescue, and a controller upgrade.

Kensington

Privacy Hedge Restoration

A neglected 80-foot ficus hedge had grown leggy and hollow inside. Three staged trims over a year brought it back to a dense, intentional privacy screen.
